run_Benchmark_evaluate: run the Benchmark.evaluate method to evaluate an agent locally or remotely and return metrics
run_Benchmark_local_evaluate: run the Benchmark.local_evaluate method to evaluate an agent in the local environment over episodes
run_Benchmark_remote_evaluate: run the Benchmark.remote_evaluate method to evaluate an agent via gRPC against a remote server
create_Benchmark_instance: create a Benchmark instance from config paths to set up local or remote agent evaluation
review_Benchmark_class: review the Benchmark class for its local and remote agent evaluation capabilities
